applies_why: The judge text addresses whether Matthew 1:20 should count as an unanswered witness for D2 vs C1 and says it was answered rather than counting it unanswered.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way. If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: The text says Matthew 1:20 was answered in [DR3] and [CR2]/[CR3] and calls the point underdetermined, so it does not count the verse as an unanswered witness, which obeys K-G4.
